description: This file is a shell script that implements tests for 'exclude_patterns' functionality in a git reference store. It defines test functions, sets up git repository state, and performs various tests to verify correct behavior of ref exclusion features.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Runs 'git for-each-ref' with exclude patterns and outputs relevant ref names.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Checks whether the trace output has the expected number of jumps based on the ref format.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Asserts that there are no jumps in the trace output.
